# GoldTus / גולדטוס

> סוכנות נסיעות פרימיום מבית אמירים טורס. טיסות פרימיום ועסקיות, מלונות יוקרה, השכרת רכב, VIP בנתב"ג, נסיעות למגזר הדתי וביטוח נסיעות.

GoldTus is a premium Israeli travel agency (a brand of Amirim Tours) offering personalized concierge travel: business and first-class flights, luxury hotels, car rentals, airport VIP service, religious-sector travel solutions, and digital travel insurance via PassportCard.

- Website: https://www.goldtus.com
- Hours: Sun–Thu 09:00–19:00, Fri 09:00–13:00 (Israel time)
- Service area: Israel (clients), worldwide destinations

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.goldtus.com/): Overview, quick quote form, why choose GoldTus.
- [Services](https://www.goldtus.com/services): Premium flights, luxury hotels, car rental, business travel, VIP at Ben Gurion airport, religious-sector travel, insurance.
- [Travel Insurance](https://www.goldtus.com/insurance): Buy PassportCard travel insurance directly online.
- [Travel Requirements Tool](https://www.goldtus.com/travel-requirements): AI-powered tool to check visa, passport, vaccination and document requirements for any destination.
- [Contact](https://www.goldtus.com/contact): Lead form, phone, WhatsApp, hours.
